sources.title: AI Visual Inspection in Manufacturing: 2026 Guide
sources.snippet: An AI visual inspection system has five layers — each must be correctly specified and connected for the system to achieve production-grade accuracy. A weakness in any layer propagates through the entire stack: inadequate lighting produces images the AI model cannot learn from; insufficient edge compute creates inference latency that breaks real-time inspection at production speed.
